rule_text: Hospital Admins can form new ownership connections between Staff and clinical protocol if the 'since' year is greater than 2000.
IT Engineers can access 'assigned to' connections where the year falls after 2020 and before 2018.
Order Managers can add any properties to Medical Order relationships if their user ID matches the owner ID.
Resource Managers are barred from deleting the 'status' property on 'owns' connections if the active flag is false.
Compliance Officers can eliminate 'transfers' relationships if the transferred amount exceeds 10000.
Chief Physicians can remove 'prescribes' associations if the dosage is greater than 500.
Head Physicians can delete 'treats' links when the priority level is 5 or above.
Head Physicians can inspect active 'treats' relationships.
Doctors can form 'prescribes' connections if the dosage is over 500.
Doctors are permitted to view 'prescribes' associations that occur on a daily frequency.
